servicesSummary: Lesotho Textile Exporters Association The registrant arranged meetings between a delegation from Lesotho and USTR officials, Congressional staff and US private sector organizations to discuss US-Lesotho trade issues, including the future of AGOA. The registrant briefed the delegation from Lesotho in preparation for such meetings. The registrant attended some of the meetings.
